integrity: The reachable and non-reachable cases were checked against the source reduction separately; the Boolean closure uses only the two property vectors actually realized by that family.
scientific_limitations: The result extracts a simultaneous consequence from an existing Minsky-machine reduction rather than introducing a new reduction.
The seven properties coincide only on the constructed family, not globally among tense Grzegorczyk extensions.
Only undecidability is transferred; no stronger arithmetical-hierarchy completeness level is claimed.
title: A two-point property spectrum for tense Grzegorczyk extensions
